description: The bar chart illustrates the bias percentage across three domains—Sports, Community, and Healthcare—before and after contact, categorized by the type of contact (No Contact, Positive Contact, Negative Contact) and the timing of the contact (Before or After). The vertical axis represents the bias percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, while the horizontal axis lists the three domains. Each domain has a group of bars representing different contact conditions: "No Contact Before" (light gray), "Positive Contact Before" (light red), "Negative Contact Before" (light blue), "No Contact After" (gray with diagonal stripes), "Positive Contact After" (red with diagonal stripes), and "Negative Contact After" (blue with diagonal stripes). In the Sports domain, the bias percentage is highest for "Negative Contact Before" at 50.05%, followed by "No Contact After" at 45.42%, and "Positive Contact After" at 43.65%. In the Community domain, the bias percentage is lowest for "No Contact Before" at 38.08%, with "Positive Contact Before" at 35.38% and "Negative Contact Before" at 40.79%. In the Healthcare domain, the bias percentage is highest for "Negative Contact Before" at 46.73%, followed by "No Contact Before" at 40.70%, and "Positive Contact Before" at 37.51%. The chart also shows that the bias percentage for "No Contact After" and "Positive Contact After" is 0.00 in the Community and Healthcare domains, indicating a significant reduction in bias after contact in these categories. The overall trend suggests that negative contact before has a higher bias percentage compared to other conditions, while positive contact after leads to a reduction in bias.
